newsitem.title: CHINA: China sees 120,000 T benzene oversupply in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China sees 120,000 T benzene oversupply in 1997.

text.p: China's benzene output is expected to reach 1.3 million tonnes in 1997, up 41 percent compared with 1996, the People's Daily Overseas Edition said on Monday.
However, output would exceed domestic demand by 120,000 tonnes, the newspaper said.

The surplus was partly as a result of excessive imports by China in 1996, and because two large production facilities were put into operation in northeastern Jilin province and southwestern Guangxi province, it said without giving further details.
